page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment: its opening letter is cut off, so it reads "tificem". The catchword "credi-" and the signature "B 2" are printed on the same line at the foot. No page number or running head is printed. The abbreviation "nosq;" is read from a small mark that is hard to make out; it is copied as "q;". The accent on "humanissimè" and "ingenuè" is read from a small, faint mark. The date "1525" is printed with spaces between the digits, which are closed up here.
